content.json:
# Arc asset inventory
*Which Azure Arc-enabled servers does this estate have, are they connected and tagged, what SQL Server runs on them and what software is installed? Servers, tags and SQL are live from Azure Resource Graph; software and heartbeats come from Log Analytics. Queries adapted from Nic Seilaz's Arc workbooks (MIT licence).*

## Estate at a glance
Live counts of Arc-enabled servers, and how many are sending telemetry right now.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == '{OsFilter}'
| extend os = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), status = tostring(properties.status)
| summarize Servers = count(), Windows = countif(os == 'windows'), Linux = countif(os == 'linux'), Connected = countif(status == 'Connected'), Offline = countif(status != 'Connected'), OfflineNames = strcat_array(make_set_if(name, status != 'Connected', 3), ', ')
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Order', 1, 'Label', 'Arc servers', 'Value', Servers, 'Note', strcat(tostring(Connected), ' connected')),
    pack('Order', 2, 'Label', 'Windows', 'Value', Windows, 'Note', 'Windows Server'),
    pack('Order', 3, 'Label', 'Linux', 'Value', Linux, 'Note', 'Linux servers'),
    pack('Order', 4, 'Label', 'Disconnected', 'Value', Offline, 'Note', iff(Offline == 0, 'All servers connected', OfflineNames)))
| mv-expand data
| extend Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = toint(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note)
content.title: Arc servers
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled servers match the operating system filter in the subscriptions you can see.

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(OSType) == '{OsFilter}'
| summarize Reporting = dcount(Computer), Newest = max(TimeGenerated)
| where Reporting > 0
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Order', 1, 'Label', 'Reporting now', 'Value', Reporting, 'Note', 'Heartbeat in the last 15 minutes'),
    pack('Order', 2, 'Label', 'Newest heartbeat', 'Value', toint(datetime_diff('second', now(), Newest)), 'Note', 'seconds ago'))
| mv-expand data
| extend Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = toint(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note)
content.title: Telemetry
content.noDataMessage: No Azure Monitor Agent heartbeat in the last 15 minutes. The lab is probably parked, so no server is reporting.

content.json:
## Servers
What the servers run and how they are connected. Select a column header to sort; use the filter box to search.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == '{OsFilter}'
| extend OperatingSystem = coalesce(tostring(properties.osSku), tostring(properties.osName))
| summarize Servers = count() by OperatingSystem
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Operating system
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled servers match the operating system filter in the subscriptions you can see.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == '{OsFilter}'
| summarize Servers = count() by AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion)
| order by AgentVersion desc
content.title: Azure Connected Machine agent version
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled servers match the operating system filter in the subscriptions you can see.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == '{OsFilter}'
| extend CostCentre = tostring(coalesce(tags.CostCentre, tags.costcentre, tags.CostCenter, tags.costcenter)), Owner = tostring(coalesce(tags.Owner, tags.owner)), Environment = tostring(coalesce(tags.Environment, tags.environment, tags.Env, tags.env))
| project Server = name, OS = coalesce(tostring(properties.osSku), tostring(properties.osName)), Status = iff(tostring(properties.status) == 'Connected', 'Connected', 'Disconnected'), AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion), LastStatusChange = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange), Environment, Owner, CostCentre, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Location = location
| order by tolower(Server) asc
content.title: Server inventory
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled servers match the operating system filter in the subscriptions you can see.

content.json:
## Tagging
Share of Arc servers carrying each required tag (green is good, red is missing); the last tile names any server that is missing one. The lab tags are `owner`, `costcenter` and `env`; the queries also accept the `CostCentre`, `Owner` and `Environment` spellings.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == '{OsFilter}'
| extend CostCentre = tostring(coalesce(tags.CostCentre, tags.costcentre, tags.CostCenter, tags.costcenter)), Owner = tostring(coalesce(tags.Owner, tags.owner)), Environment = tostring(coalesce(tags.Environment, tags.environment, tags.Env, tags.env))
| extend Untagged = isempty(CostCentre) or isempty(Owner) or isempty(Environment)
| summarize Total = count(), HasCostCentre = countif(isnotempty(CostCentre)), HasOwner = countif(isnotempty(Owner)), HasEnvironment = countif(isnotempty(Environment)), FullyTagged = countif(not(Untagged)), MissingNames = strcat_array(make_set_if(name, Untagged, 2), ', ')
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Order', 1, 'Label', 'Cost centre tag', 'Value', iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * HasCostCentre / Total, 1)), 'Note', strcat(tostring(HasCostCentre), ' of ', tostring(Total), ' servers')),
    pack('Order', 2, 'Label', 'Owner tag', 'Value', iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * HasOwner / Total, 1)), 'Note', strcat(tostring(HasOwner), ' of ', tostring(Total), ' servers')),
    pack('Order', 3, 'Label', 'Environment tag', 'Value', iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * HasEnvironment / Total, 1)), 'Note', strcat(tostring(HasEnvironment), ' of ', tostring(Total), ' servers')),
    pack('Order', 4, 'Label', 'Fully tagged', 'Value', iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * FullyTagged / Total, 1)), 'Note', iff(FullyTagged == Total, strcat('all ', tostring(Total), ' servers carry every tag'), substring(strcat('missing: ', MissingNames), 0, 40))))
| mv-expand data
| extend Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = todouble(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note)
content.title: Tag coverage
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled servers match the operating system filter in the subscriptions you can see.

content.json:
## SQL Server
Arc-enabled SQL Server instances, their edition and licence. Real SQL Server on a host without the Arc SQL extension is not listed here.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend version = tostring(properties.version), defender = tostring(properties.azureDefenderStatus), vcores = toint(properties.vCore)
| summarize Instances = count(), Protected = countif(defender =~ 'Protected'), VCores = sum(vcores), Unsupported = countif(version has_any ('2008', '2012', '2014') or version startswith '10.' or version startswith '11.' or version startswith '12.')
| project data = pack_array(
    pack('Order', 1, 'Label', 'SQL instances', 'Value', Instances, 'Note', 'Arc-enabled SQL Server'),
    pack('Order', 2, 'Label', 'Defender protected', 'Value', Protected, 'Note', iff(Instances == 1, 'of 1 instance', strcat('of ', tostring(Instances), ' instances'))),
    pack('Order', 3, 'Label', 'Total vCores', 'Value', VCores, 'Note', 'across the instances'),
    pack('Order', 4, 'Label', 'Unsupported', 'Value', Unsupported, 'Note', 'SQL Server 2014 or older'))
| mv-expand data
| extend Order = toint(data.Order)
| order by Order asc
| project Label = tostring(data.Label), Value = toint(data.Value), Note = tostring(data.Note)
content.title: SQL Server instances
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instances were found. SQL Server is inventoried here only when the Arc SQL Server extension is installed on the host (in this lab, the nested guest).

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| summarize Instances = count() by Edition = tostring(properties.edition)
| order by Instances desc
content.title: Edition
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instances were found. SQL Server is inventoried here only when the Arc SQL Server extension is installed on the host (in this lab, the nested guest).

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| extend License = case(tostring(properties.licenseType) =~ 'PAYG', 'Pay-as-you-go', tostring(properties.licenseType) =~ 'Paid', 'Perpetual licence', tostring(properties.licenseType) =~ 'LicenseOnly', 'Azure Hybrid Benefit', tostring(properties.licenseType) =~ 'Free', 'Free (Developer or Express)', 'Not reported')
| summarize Instances = count() by License
| order by Instances desc
content.title: Licence type
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instances were found. SQL Server is inventoried here only when the Arc SQL Server extension is installed on the host (in this lab, the nested guest).

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| project Server = tostring(split(properties.containerResourceId, '/')[8]), Instance = name, Edition = tostring(properties.edition), Version = tostring(properties.version), License = tostring(properties.licenseType), Defender = tostring(properties.azureDefenderStatus), VCores = toint(properties.vCore), Status = tostring(properties.status), ResourceGroup = resourceGroup
| order by tolower(Server) asc
content.title: SQL Server instance inventory
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled SQL Server instances were found. SQL Server is inventoried here only when the Arc SQL Server extension is installed on the host (in this lab, the nested guest).

content.json:
## Software
Installed software from Change Tracking and Inventory (Windows applications and Linux packages) over the selected time range. Defender Antivirus definition and platform updates are grouped into one row each so they do not swamp the lists. Servers without the Azure Monitor Agent, such as the nested SQL guest, are not included.

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType == 'Software'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CurrentVersion, Publisher) by Computer, SoftwareName
| extend Software = case(SoftwareName startswith 'Security Intelligence Update for Microsoft Defender Antivirus', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus definitions', SoftwareName matches regex @'^Update for (Microsoft|Windows) Defender Antivirus antimalware platform', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus platform', SoftwareName), PublisherName = trim(' ', replace_regex(Publisher, @'\s*<[^>]*>', ''))
| summarize Servers = dcount(Computer), Versions = dcount(CurrentVersion) by Software, PublisherName
| order by Servers desc, Software asc
| take 15
| project Software, Publisher = PublisherName, Servers, Versions
content.title: Most widely installed software
content.noDataMessage: No software inventory in the selected time range. Change Tracking and Inventory reports software only from Arc servers running the Azure Monitor Agent, and a parked lab reports nothing.

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType == 'Software'
| where isnotempty(Publisher)
| extend Software = case(SoftwareName startswith 'Security Intelligence Update for Microsoft Defender Antivirus', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus definitions', SoftwareName matches regex @'^Update for (Microsoft|Windows) Defender Antivirus antimalware platform', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus platform', SoftwareName), PublisherName = trim(' ', replace_regex(Publisher, @'\s*<[^>]*>', ''))
| summarize Installs = dcount(strcat(Computer, '|', Software)), Servers = dcount(Computer), Products = dcount(Software) by Publisher = PublisherName
| order by Installs desc, Publisher asc
| take 10
| project Publisher, Products, Installs, Servers
content.title: Software by publisher
content.noDataMessage: No software inventory in the selected time range. Change Tracking and Inventory reports software only from Arc servers running the Azure Monitor Agent, and a parked lab reports nothing.

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType == 'Software'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CurrentVersion) by Computer, SoftwareName
| extend Software = case(SoftwareName startswith 'Security Intelligence Update for Microsoft Defender Antivirus', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus definitions', SoftwareName matches regex @'^Update for (Microsoft|Windows) Defender Antivirus antimalware platform', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus platform', SoftwareName)
| where Software !startswith 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus'
| summarize Versions = dcount(CurrentVersion), Servers = dcount(Computer), VersionList = make_set(CurrentVersion, 6) by Software
| where Versions > 1
| order by Versions desc, Software asc
| take 10
| project Software, Versions, Servers, VersionList = strcat_array(VersionList, ', ')
content.title: Software on more than one version
content.noDataMessage: Good news: every software item in the selected time range is on a single version across the estate.

content.query:
ConfigurationChange
| where ConfigChangeType == 'Software' and isnotempty(ChangeCategory)
| extend Software = case(SoftwareName startswith 'Security Intelligence Update for Microsoft Defender Antivirus', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus definitions', SoftwareName matches regex @'^Update for (Microsoft|Windows) Defender Antivirus antimalware platform', 'Microsoft Defender Antivirus platform', SoftwareName)
| summarize Changes = count(), Servers = dcount(Computer), ServerList = strcat_array(make_set(Computer, 3), ', '), arg_max(TimeGenerated, Current, Previous) by Change = ChangeCategory, Software
| project LastChange = TimeGenerated, Change, Software, Servers, Changes, Version = iff(Change == 'Removed', Previous, Current), ServerList
| order by LastChange desc, Software asc
| take 50
content.title: Recent software changes
content.noDataMessage: No software was added, updated or removed on any server in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Telemetry coverage
When each server last sent an Azure Monitor Agent heartbeat. An Arc server missing here is connected to Azure but not sending telemetry (the nested SQL guest has no Azure Monitor Agent).

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where '{OsFilter}' in ('', '*', 'value::all') or tolower(OSType) == '{OsFilter}'
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Server = Computer, OS = OSType
| extend MinutesAgo = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat)
| extend State = iff(MinutesAgo <= 10, 'Reporting', 'Not reporting')
| project Server, OS, State, LastHeartbeat, MinutesAgo
| order by tolower(Server) asc
content.title: Last heartbeat by server
content.noDataMessage: No heartbeats in the selected time range. The lab is probably parked, so no server is reporting.

content.json: *Counts are live. **Reporting** means a heartbeat in the last 10 to 15 minutes. Arc servers without the Azure Monitor Agent appear in the inventory, tagging and SQL sections but not in the software or telemetry views.*
